cohort: The study included 85 infants diagnosed with infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis (IHPS) whose medical records were reviewed from a single tertiary center between 2009 and 2018.
finding: Favorable nutritional outcomes and successful weight gain were observed 6-8 weeks after surgery in children with IHPS, with pyloric muscle thickness positively correlating with age, weight, symptom duration, and favorable nutritional recovery, and serum bicarbonate showing a positive correlation with symptom duration.
